_note: The BagelUnit sticker host recipe. 'style' is pasted into every prompt so all poses match. 'starter' is the 10-pack made after the base pose is approved. 'extra' are proven poses to add when a reel needs them; any new pose follows the same pattern. {OUTFIT} and {BG} are filled from brand/host/host.json.

canvas._note: every finished pose is this size, bust bottom on the bottom edge, so switching poses never makes the host jump

style: A die-cut sticker illustration of the person in the reference photo, drawn as a friendly cartoon. Head and upper body only (a bust, cut straight across at the waist), facing the viewer, centred. Bold dark outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading, a slightly large head and expressive eyes. Keep the person's real face shape, skin tone, hair and facial hair so they are clearly recognisable. Wearing {OUTFIT}, plain, with nothing printed on it. A clean white sticker border about 12 px wide all the way around the figure, with a thin dark line outside it. Plain flat {BG} background, nothing else in the picture: no text, no logo, no props unless the pose names one. Same scale and framing as the reference pose: the top of the head about 8 percent below the top edge, the bust cut at the bottom edge. Portrait image.

base.name: idle
base.prompt: {STYLE} Pose: relaxed and neutral, arms down by the sides, a small friendly closed-mouth smile, looking straight at the viewer.
base.use: the default between moments; every other pose is drawn from this one

starter.name: idle
starter.pose: relaxed and neutral, arms down by the sides, a small friendly closed-mouth smile, looking straight at the viewer

starter.name: point
starter.use: aims at the newest thing on stage
starter.pose: pointing up and to the right with the right index finger, arm raised diagonally, head turned slightly toward the finger, open-mouth smile

starter.name: raise
starter.pose: one index finger raised beside the face, the other arm down, eyebrows up, a knowing smile

starter.name: thumbs
starter.pose: one thumbs-up held in front of the chest, a big confident smile

starter.name: shock
starter.pose: both palms on the cheeks, eyes wide open, mouth in a round O

starter.name: think
starter.pose: chin resting on a thumb and bent index finger, eyes looking up and to the side, a slight smile

starter.name: shrug
starter.pose: both palms turned up at shoulder height, shoulders raised, eyebrows up, a small lopsided smile

starter.name: wave
starter.pose: one open hand raised high in a wave, palm facing the viewer, a warm open-mouth smile

starter.name: open
starter.pose: one hand held out to the side at waist height, palm up, as if presenting something, a friendly smile

starter.name: celebrate
starter.pose: both fists raised above the shoulders in celebration, eyes squeezed shut with joy, a wide open-mouth laugh

extra.name: guns
extra.pose: both hands making finger guns pointed at the viewer, one eye winking, a cheeky grin

extra.name: magnifier
extra.pose: holding a round magnifying glass up to one eye, the eye big behind the lens, a curious look

extra.name: facepalm
extra.pose: one palm covering the forehead and eyes, head tilted down, an embarrassed smile

extra.name: tshirt
extra.use: pointing at the logo on the chest
extra.pose: both index fingers pointing down at the middle of the chest, a proud smile

extra.name: one
extra.pose: one hand raised beside the shoulder showing one finger (index finger up), a friendly smile

extra.name: two
extra.pose: one hand raised beside the shoulder showing two fingers (a V), a friendly smile

extra.name: three
extra.pose: one hand raised beside the shoulder showing exactly three fingers (index, middle and ring), thumb and little finger folded, a friendly smile

extra.name: four
extra.pose: one hand raised beside the shoulder showing exactly four fingers, thumb folded across the palm, a friendly smile

extra.name: five
extra.pose: one open hand raised beside the shoulder showing all five fingers spread, a friendly smile

new_pose_rule: A new pose gets a short lowercase name (one word, or words joined by dashes), one line saying what the body, hands and face do, and one line saying when a reel uses it. It is drawn from the approved base pose with the same style, so the set stays consistent.
